response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS bench1 FROM per_order), first_pass AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b1.bench1 AS margin1, b1.bench1 FROM per_order p CROSS JOIN b1 WHERE p.avg_fill > b1.bench1), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS bench2 FROM first_pass), second_pass AS (SELECT f.ordersmark, f.avg_fill, f.margin1, f.avg_fill - b2.bench2 AS margin2 FROM first_pass f CROSS JOIN b2 WHERE f.avg_fill > b2.bench2) SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_fill_size, AVG(margin1) AS avg_margin_over_first_benchmark, AVG(margin2) AS avg_margin_over_second_benchmark FROM second_pass
